description: This file is a shell script used for building, patching, testing, and generating coverage reports for the entservices appgateway project. It manages the checkout of dependencies, configuration of build environments, application of patches, and execution of tests with coverage collection.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command is available in the system PATH.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Ensures that the given repository directory is checked out at the specified git ref/tag.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones or updates a git repository at a specified ref.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch file to a repository directory if not already applied.

methods.name: build_dir_configured
methods.description: Checks whether a build directory has been configured with CMake.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a project component using CMake with optional extra args.
